notes: Manufacturer spec sheets (DTEN D7 55" and D7 75", both v2.2a, checked directly) list identical Inputs & Outputs for both screen sizes: HDMI Out x1, HDMI In x1, USB 3.0 x2, 3.5-mm Audio Jack x1, Microphone x1, Ethernet LAN (RJ45) x1, plus Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac (not a physical port). A "DTEN D7 Dual 55\"" spec sheet also exists (dual-screen variant) but was not checked; its physical rear I/O is likely the same single-panel connector set duplicated or shared. DTEN's current site now foregrounds the successor "D7X" line — the original D7 spec PDFs are still hosted but not linked from primary navigation. HDMI version/generation is not stated by DTEN. USB-A form factor and the assumed 3.5mm/IEC connector types for the audio jack, mic, and power inlet are inferred (not explicitly printed) — confirmed the USB-A form factor via a secondary user-manual excerpt (manua.ls). Power input voltage range (100-240V AC, 50-60Hz, auto-switching) is confirmed directly from DTEN.
